calls.title: Karen / Kari
calls.summary: The team discussed the homepage design strategy, agreeing on a modern carousel-style hero section with simplified calls to action. Karen Henke emphasized the importance of maintaining a cohesive visual language while avoiding clutter, and Kari Kay confirmed alignment with previous mockups. They addressed the need for updated messaging, shifting from 'Safe Rollouts' to 'Feature Flag Management' to better reflect product capabilities. The participants noted inconsistencies between homepage and feature page content, stressing the importance of aligning visuals and copy before presenting to executives. Resource challenges were highlighted, particularly the lack of senior leadership in the design team, which has led to rushed work. They also discussed creating a consistent visual language by repurposing illustrations across various pages, ensuring that messaging remains clear and outcome-focused.
calls.keywords: homepage hero, feature flags, controlled rollouts, illustrations, product marketing, design review

calls.title: Karen / Kari
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for optimizing content layout and visual design to enhance user engagement and comprehension. They agreed to structure the page with clear, skimmable sections instead of lengthy blocks of text, emphasizing the importance of readability. Kari Kay presented various section options, ensuring a maximum of 120 characters per three lines for better layout balance. In visual design, they opted for a collage or minimal animation for the hero section instead of a single screenshot, with Karen Henke advocating for reduced clutter. They also decided to implement FigJam for collaborative layout planning, aiming to streamline editing and feedback. Challenges with design and content timing were highlighted, stressing the need for content approval prior to design reviews. Lastly, the team identified inconsistencies in design elements requiring correction to meet brand standards, while also emphasizing the importance of team wellbeing amidst workload pressures.
calls.keywords: Content Architecture, FigJam Collaboration, Design Feedback, Homepage Layout, User Experience, Badge Styling
